div.p: We see you haven't activated your payments feature in Odoo yet. By enabling it, you'll be able to process payments directly and efficiently through your Odoo account.
Of course, if you've already activated payments since receiving this email, you can simply ignore this message.
Ready to get started? Activate your payments here! You can also complete this setup later by visiting your scheduled activities within Odoo.
